stewardship.deescalation: Not applicable. Reassess if blood appears in stool, fever develops, or symptoms persist beyond expected course - this would reclassify the case as dysentery/invasive diarrhea.
framework: Antibiotics are not indicated for watery, non-bloody, non-febrile diarrhea - they do not improve outcomes and may select for resistance.
Oral rehydration solution is the primary, evidence-based intervention.
Antimotility agents should be avoided if there is any suspicion of invasive bacterial infection.
